items.title: Investor Warns: Quantum “One of the Most Overhyped Technologies of Our Time.” IonQ Is Down 25% in a Month
items.summary: Key TakeawaysIonQ stock is down 25% in the past month, and Rigetti Computing and D-Wave Quantum have fallen even further. Dmitri Alperovitch argues AI will likely break today’s encryption before quantum computers can, taking away one of quantum’s few sure uses.
